market_regime: Choppy Pre-Market / Delayed 10:30 Macro Liquidity Trap

w2_0830_hunt.notes: No true liquidity hunt at 8:30; chop continued with no direction.

w4_1030_macro.behavior: Ran all session highs to 28,760, trapped breakout buyers, then collapsed 344 pts to 28,416.

agent_decision: Initial 09:30 long bias was vulnerable to chop. The true high-probability move was the 10:30 macro exhaustion reversal after all highs were purged.
actual_outcome: Delayed sweep at 10:30 open took out all highs, followed by a massive 340+ point crash.
lesson_learned: When 07:30 is a range and NO liquidity hunt occurs on the 08:30 open (choppy, no clear direction), expect smart money to delay the purge until 10:30. At 10:30, it takes out all highs, traps late buyers, and reverses aggressively downward.

w3_0930_open.behavior: Violent Judas dump to 28,470 followed by V-reversal

w4_1030_macro.behavior: Complete delivery into 07:30 high (28,690) by 10:15, then stalled.

agent_decision: Do not enter breakout at 09:30. Wait for Judas flush of range low, then buy reversal.
actual_outcome: Judas dump swept lows, then rallied 220 points straight into 07:30 high.
lesson_learned: When 08:30 is completely compressed inside 07:30 range, 09:30 open will almost always produce a violent fakeout (Judas) purging one side before reversing to the other.
